en: The root "ظلم" (ẓalam) primarily means to put something in a wrong place or to transgress proper limits. It encompasses doing wrong, acting unjustly, or causing
The root ظنن primarily means to think, imagine, or suppose something to be true, often with an element of doubt or uncertainty.
The root "zhhr" primarily refers to the back, contrasting with the belly. It can metaphorically describe having a large or small household, or being forgotten/n
